name: shinchantw_cbt_tc_100501_locator_20260729_184400_299533
sql:
SELECT "$part_event" AS event_name,
       COUNT(*) AS events,
       COUNT(DISTINCT "#account_id") AS accounts,
       MIN("#event_time") AS first_time,
       MAX("#event_time") AS last_time,
       ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR)), ',') AS charge_product_ids
FROM ta.v_event_18
WHERE "$part_date"='2026-07-29'
  AND (
    CAST(TRY_CAST(product_id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT)=100501
    OR COALESCE(TRY_CAST(shop_item[1].shop_id AS BIGINT),-1)=100501
    OR COALESCE(TRY_CAST(shop_item[1].item_id AS BIGINT),-1)=100501
    OR ANY_MATCH(a_rst, x -> CAST(TRY_CAST(x.id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT)=100501)
  )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;
